description: This is a Java test class for the PresentationMessageMap class, containing unit tests for message localization behavior within the OpenMRS messaging system.

classes.name: PresentationMessageMapTest
classes.description: Unit test class for PresentationMessageMap, testing locale-specific message handling.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes a PresentationMessageMap with English locale before each test.

methods.name: put_shouldShouldIgnoreNonMatchingLocaleMessages
methods.description: Tests that PresentationMessageMap ignores messages that do not match its configured locale when adding individually.

methods.name: putAll_shouldFilterOutNonMatchingLocaleMessagesFromBatchAdd
methods.description: Tests that PresentationMessageMap filters out messages with non-matching locales when adding a batch of messages.
